name: Sandstorm
description: On a desert dune at sunset, a storm front strips the subject away grain by grain.

wardrobe.man: a loose sand-colored linen shirt and trousers
wardrobe.woman: a long flowing sand-colored linen dress

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands on the crest of a tall desert dune at late afternoon, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, the fabric and hair blown toward the right of the frame. Behind {them}, a towering wall of orange dust rises on the horizon and rolls closer, the low sun a pale disc inside it, and ripples of wind-carved sand run across the dunes. Low-angle wide shot from the slope below, the {subject} centered against the storm, full body visible. Cinematic desert photography, warm amber backlight filtered through dust, long soft shadows. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, untouched dunes and a clean sky throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands on the dune crest facing the camera as the storm front arrives behind {them}, wind whipping the clothes and hair to the right, eyes on a point just past the camera. The body erodes into fine golden sand from the back toward the front, streams of grains pulled off the shoulders, the arms and finally the face and carried away to the right of frame, until by the last second the figure is gone, a last trickle of sand pours into the dune where the {subject} stood, and the amber storm fills the frame. The camera holds the low angle and drifts slowly to the right with the sand. Sound: a rising roar of wind, a dry hiss of moving sand, fabric snapping in the gusts. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, sand particle simulation with real weight and wind, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays still as a strong wind rises. The body erodes into fine golden sand, streams of grains pulled off the shoulders, the arms and finally the face and carried away to one side, until by the last second the {subject} is gone and a last trickle of sand pours to the ground where {their} feet were. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a rising roar of wind, a dry hiss of moving sand. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, sand particle simulation with real weight and wind, sharp detail, stable picture.
